analyst_view.overall: NEC (12th, 7 points) and Rennes (17th, 6 points) are both in the play-off places and a win would push either toward the top eight. NEC lost 4-1 at home to PSV on Saturday and their defence is thin: Perr Schuurs and Bram Nuytinck are out, Philippe Sandler had a setback and Deveron Fonville returned from international duty with a knock; the numbers only count Schuurs (and Emre Mor) on the scoring side. Rennes are four without a win, the latest a 1-1 at Lorient on Sunday, and Franck Haise is under pressure; captain Valentin Rongier went off with a thigh problem but Haise says he could be fit, and striker Eliezer Mayenda missed Lorient with calf discomfort. The numbers count only Frankowski for Rennes. No referee named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals, a high figure for two open sides, and already take a little off for Schuurs, Mor and Frankowski. NEC's depleted centre-backs (Nuytinck, Sandler, Fonville doubtful) point up after shipping four to PSV, while Rennes possibly missing Mayenda and Rongier points down; these roughly cancel, so I stay at 3.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, already up for NEC's 38 corners in their last six and trimmed for Rennes's lower count. Nothing new on style or lineups points either way, so I stay at 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards with both sides near their usual counts. Rennes's poor run and the pressure on Haise could add some edge, but that is a hunch and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.1 shots, already up about 5% for NEC's busy recent shooting (105 in six). Rennes's doubts in attack and NEC's problems at the back pull in opposite directions, so I stay at 29.1.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target, already raised for NEC's 40 on target in their last six. Boulaye Dia can lead the line for Rennes if Mayenda is out, so nothing moves this; I stay at 10.4.
